description: The JUnit engine and annotation API in org.junit.jupiter.api, introduced with JUnit 5 and kept in JUnit 6.
A new test class instance per method, with BeforeAll, BeforeEach, AfterEach and AfterAll methods running around the tests.
An assertion that runs code, fails if the expected exception type is not thrown and returns the exception for further checks.
A grouped assertion that runs every check and reports all failures together instead of stopping at the first.
A fluent assertion library started with assertThat and chained with checks such as containsExactly and hasMessageContaining.
A test method run once per input row supplied by ValueSource, CsvSource or MethodSource.
A non-static inner class annotated Nested that groups tests sharing a setup, run after the outer BeforeEach.
A readable label for a test or class set with DisplayName or a display name generator.
